periods.time: Same day, Denatus at Babel Tower

name.zh: 诸神大会授予贝尔【小新秀】称号

periods.location: Babel Tower, 30th floor Denatus hall; later Guild second office
periods.summary: At Denatus, Loki chairs a chaotic naming ceremony. When Bell's file appears, Loki challenges his impossible growth and Hestia nearly has to reveal his secret, but Freya deflects the interrogation and asks the gods to give Bell a cute title. The final result reaches the Guild: Bell's alias is Little Rookie.
periods.cause: Bell's promotion to Lv.2 qualifies him for a god-given alias at the quarterly Denatus.
periods.process: The gods first exchange information and mockingly name other adventurers. Loki then questions Bell's one-and-a-half-month level-up record, Freya reframes the matter around Minotaur experience and privacy rules, and the gods resume title selection under Freya's influence.
periods.outcome: Bell receives the official alias Little Rookie, a gentle title compared with the humiliating names many gods proposed for others.
periods.aftermath: Loki warns Hestia that Freya's defense of Bell is dangerous, and Eina smiles when she reads Bell's new alias at the Guild.
periods.significance: Gives Bell the public identity he carries after reaching Lv.2 and reveals divine political interest in his abnormal growth.
